title: Natural Q&A #5
summary: A short Q&A where NH talks about controlling ads on his channel, the idea of an online natural bodybuilding show, talking with his hands, his genetic crooked pinky, how he relates to work and money, coping with loved ones' mortality, his religious and reincarnation views, and training while sick or sleep-deprived.
claims: His channel is too small, mostly beginners, to run an online natural bodybuilding show
He would enter an online natural show without cutting for it, showing up with his muscle and fat
He talks with his hands because half his family is Spanish; it also helps viewers follow his unedited videos
Both his pinkies are naturally crooked from a hereditary missing-tendon condition passed down from his great-grandfather; it doesn't affect lifting
He loves being productive and repetitive work, so he enjoys most jobs
A purely mental job is a blessing for bodybuilding because all physical energy goes to training; bodybuilding with a blue collar job is tough
Kids shouldn't have to worry about money; he has a detached relationship with money and hasn't looked at a paycheck in years
Men in his family die young, the previous generation before 60, so he'd be happy to reach 60
Accept that losing parents will be terrible instead of running from it, or the shock will hit harder
Mortality is what makes life worth living; immortality would be a curse
He is religious in his own way: no literal heaven or hell, they coexist on earth, and he believes in a form of reincarnation
He hasn't been sick in about 10 years and still trains when he feels weak, underslept or a sickness coming on; training makes him feel better
If a little unwell, hungry or underslept, still train but avoid heavy work; real flu may be the exception
Skipping training because you failed to eat or sleep reinforces bad behaviour; training is non-negotiable
viewer_questions: love for his job and attitude to money
